The last all-false marker is consistent with pre-publication refusal and inconsistent with those specific unrecovered post-publication failure arms.

Service recovery_required=false is not durable.recovery_required=false for the still-local cold DurableService. A generic mapper does not prove zero durable staging or zero earlier successful local publication.
